title: It’s been a full 24 hours since I started developing this game…
author: NoSociety2178
selftext: I posted yesterday, a lot of people hated the music and hated that the UI was stressful. This is all done in Claude opus 5. This is a work in progress, more updates to come.

comments.author: luka_makes_games
comments.body: Really cool, love it. Mind sharing the prompt for the rolling hills and trees?

replies.author: NoSociety2178
replies.body:
Review this, this is how we build the world map: [https://discourse.threejs.org/t/tesseract-open-world-planetary-engine/1473?page=2](https://discourse.threejs.org/t/tesseract-open-world-planetary-engine/1473?page=2)  
I will attach a series of files that’ll help us build the environment. I do it in phases so we can go one at a time.  
I also want zero UI so it should all be intuitive/instinctual visual indicators in game world.

NOTE: I searched and used various GitHub shared code and had Claude adjust or change where it made sense. References were given like art so I could get the vibe across and several prompts to tweak.

replies.author: NoSociety2178
replies.body: I did just remember earlier on, one of the first prompts I specified making the terrain like a natural skate park.

comments.author: Historical-Youth8705
comments.body: Wow, can you give me the prompt of you how got the cape to twist around and distort like that on the back of the body? And how the grass blocks the camera view. Would love to implement those in my Duolingo but for chess game
